variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Oh, it's hopeless! Hopeless!

The Urchins from the old barrow east of the ford got into my mill and ran off with the mill key! Now I'm locked out of my own mill! Those wretched Urchins are a plague on honest folk!

Tobin went after them with my good frying pan, and he hasn't come back. Will you go into the barrow and bring back my key? I will offer a worthy reward.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
My key! You found my key! Now the wheel can turn again!

May all that is great bless you! Please, take this ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Find the key to Wenna's mill in the old barrow.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Brave enough to walk right up to my gate. But that won't get you through it! Now move along!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: I hear the wolves are bold this year. Good for business, friend!

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: You're mighty scrawny for a bandit-chaser. Hah, hah, hah...!

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: Well you sure don't look like much. I'm glad you aren't the one guarding our gate.

variants.specifics: Krennack: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Toskel
offer.text:
Ahem. You there, stranger. The Mining Council has ordered that the Troll squatting in the old Counting House be evicted at once. As Warden, the duty falls to me.

I have the notice right here, signed and sealed. But that Troll is the biggest, smelliest lout ever to set foot in Krennack! Ever since the Ogres took the Great Lift, every brute in the mountain thinks he can just move in!

The Counting House is at the east end of town. Get that Troll out of there, by whatever means you like, and the Council will see you rewarded.

completion.speaker: Toskel
completion.text:
Excellent work! The Counting House is fit for honest folk again, and I never had to set one foot inside!

On behalf of the Mining Council, I present you with this shield. Wear it with pride!

journal.text: Evict the Troll squatting in the old Counting House.

guard.speaker: Stobb
guard.text: Where have you been? The Foreman has been asking for you all morning! You'd best get over to the Pit Office if you ever want to see the Great Lift running again. The Ogres won't leave by themselves.

shop.speaker: Zilva
shop.text: Word gets around. Get out, before I hex the beard off your chin!

townsfolk1.speaker: Gant
townsfolk1.text: Foreman Brakkus is over at the Pit Office. He keeps the keys to every shaft in Krennack.

townsfolk2.speaker: Dolla
townsfolk2.text: Oh No! An Ogre! Hide the gold!

variants.specifics: Skell: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ysolt
offer.text:
Oh, I'm a silly old fool! A pedlar came by yesterday with a magic amulet -- the Moon Amulet, he called it. I paid him every coin I had!

That very night it was stolen right off my table. And the pedlar? He was an Urchin in a big hat! They've sold that same amulet to half the village!

The Urchins hide in the hollow tree west of here. Will you get my amulet back, kind sir? I'll find some way to repay you.

completion.speaker: Ysolt
completion.text: My Moon Amulet! Oh, bless you, kind sir, bless you! I spent all my gold on it, so please take this spell book instead. I hope it serves you well.

journal.text: Recover Ysolt's amulet... before it's sold again.

guard.speaker: Warden Brodd
guard.text: Hold it right there, stranger! Mother Hesk says you tracked swamp mud all through her shop and her floor testifies to it! Come on. I've got a damp, drafty cell waiting just for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

shop.speaker: Oggin
shop.text: Welcome, welcome! I smell my favorite smell -- a stranger with a full purse.

townsfolk1.speaker: Corra
townsfolk1.text: I thought adventurers never got lost. Try following the lanterns.

townsfolk2.speaker: Tibbet
townsfolk2.text: I do all right selling frog legs.

variants.specifics: Varrok: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gessa
offer.text:
Thieves! Thieves in my bathhouse!

Every night a gang of Rogues creeps in and carries off all my soap and towels. Those miserable rascals will be the ruin of me! The soldiers stink to high heaven, and nobody pays for a bath without soap!

The Rogues hide out in the old quarry west of town. Run them off for good and I'll pay you handsomely.

completion.speaker: Gessa
completion.text:
Gone? The Rogues are really gone?! Oh, happy day! Tonight every soldier in Varrok gets a proper bath!

Here's 100 gold, as promised. You've saved my business, brave Adventurer!

guard.speaker: Bolk
guard.text: Absolutely not! Off with you, ruffian!

shop.speaker: Brask
shop.text: What brings you to my forge, stranger? I've no time to waste.

townsfolk1.speaker: Soldier
townsfolk1.text: Find that Grukk and knock his ugly head clean off!

townsfolk2.speaker: Pellam
townsfolk2.text: Did you see where my cart went? It couldn't have just rolled off by itself!

variants.specifics: Kesk: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wessa
offer.text:
Rotten little thieves! The Urchins came in the night and took my Fishing Amulet right off my boat!

The Mayor's fishing contest is in a few days. Without that amulet I won't catch a thing! It makes the fish practically leap into the net. Well... it's not cheating if nobody finds out.

Their caves are up on the north shore. Will you get it back for me?

completion.speaker: Wessa
completion.text:
My amulet! Oh, you wonderful thing! Those fish don't stand a chance now!

Here, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation. And not a word to anyone about the contest!

guard.speaker: Dorvic
guard.text: Tull, here is one more brave soul who wishes to go swimming with Skarn's dead men!

shop.speaker: Pellik
shop.text: The dead came up out of the lake again. Need a potion?

townsfolk1.speaker: Fennic
townsfolk1.text: There is a weapon smith next to Selka's inn.

townsfolk2.speaker: Yarnoth
townsfolk2.text: We must take up our oars and send those dead things back to the bottom of the lake!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Pellock
offer.text:
Don't look at my chin! Don't you dare look at it!

Those Wisps from Bramble Orchard set my beard on fire while I was napping under the apple trees! Years to grow it, and gone in one puff! The students giggle every time I walk into class. These blasted Wisps are worse than a plague of rats!

Go out to the orchard, east of the College, and put out every last one of them. I'll pay you well.

completion.speaker: Pellock
completion.text:
The Wisps are gone? Ha! Now my beard can grow back in peace!

Thank you, stranger. Here are 100 gold pieces and a Spell Book. Spend them wisely!

journal.text: Go out to Bramble Orchard and destroy the Wisps.

guard.speaker: Brusk
guard.text: Wanna get yourself turned into a toad?

shop.speaker: Mossop
shop.text: Traveler, eh? You'd better turn around while you can. No doubt Malgrin's Ogres will come knocking here soon, too! Strange days we're living in, isn't it?

townsfolk1.speaker: Dilly
townsfolk1.text: There is a wicked old wizard -- Malgrin -- hiding out in the Gloomfen. They say the College threw him out for turning his teacher into a goat!

townsfolk2.speaker: Gasper
townsfolk2.text: We have mastered the Fireball! Now we must burn every last Ogre out of the Gloomfen!

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Tibbet
offer.text:
Ruined! I'm ruined! Rogues broke into my shop last night and took my magic shears! Without them I can't cut a single fur, and the whole garrison is waiting on winter coats!

Those thieves are holed up in the old toll house down the west road. Will you get my shears back for me, young sir?

completion.speaker: Tibbet
completion.text:
My shears! Oh, my beautiful shears! Now I can get back to work!

I can't offer much till the coats are sold, but take these boots. A token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Go to the toll house and take back Tibbet's shears.

guard.speaker: Hask
guard.text: I thought you lowlanders could take a little cold. Try stamping your feet.

shop.speaker: Gorm
shop.text: Hard times, lad. I can't believe the Undead got as far as the Upper Gate. A black day indeed! Best buy what you need while I've still got it!

townsfolk1.speaker: Fennick
townsfolk1.text: Help! Help! My tongue's stuck to the railing!

townsfolk2.speaker: Brannoc
townsfolk2.text: Beware! Those Undead grow bolder every night!

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Pelgrim
offer.text:
Don't you laugh! Don't you dare laugh! I was walking home past the Old Smelter when a swarm of Bats came screeching out and snatched the wig clean off my head! In front of the whole street!

I'll never show my face at the forge again! They roost inside the place, west of the town well. Drive them out and I'll pay you handsomely.

completion.speaker: Pelgrim
completion.text: My wig! You found my wig too! Oh, I'm a new man! Here -- 90 gold, as I promised.

journal.text: Drive the Bats from their roost in the Old Smelter.

shop.speaker: Zibbet
shop.text: Pssst! Hey! Stranger! Want a potion? Cheapest in town and they're brewed right over the lava of Kalgarr!

townsfolk1.speaker: Brix
townsfolk1.text: Malgrith must have learned the forbidden secrets of fire. One morning the Deep Furnace was quiet and by supper it was boiling over with Ember Demons and Imps! They want our forges.

townsfolk2.speaker: Grizzel
townsfolk2.text: Hurry, hero, hurry! Hee, hee, hee...!

variants.specifics: Torvel: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Oh, it's terrible! My husband Gorvin has been turned into a goat!

Those thieving Urchins crept in last night and took his Amulet of Warding right off the bedpost. He never takes it off! And the moment it was gone... BAAAAA!

The Urchins hide in the Pitch Caves, east of the crossroads. Please, will you bring back the Amulet?

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text:
The Amulet! You found it!

Gorvin! Come here, Gorvin! ... Oh! He's himself again! Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this Ankh. May all that is great bless you!

journal.text: Find the Pitch Caves east of the crossroads. The Urchins hiding there have stolen the Amulet of Warding from Nella's house.

guard.speaker: Brask
guard.text: I'm told the bandits up at Varga Tower lately robbed a tinker of his own trousers. Nasty business all over these days.

shop.speaker: Bertol
shop.text: So, now you've met both Brask at the gate and our Mayor. Welcome to the Crooked Crown, young sir!

townsfolk1.speaker: Tobb
townsfolk1.text: Welcome to Torvel. The Crooked Crown is the big house on your left.

townsfolk2.speaker: Dorla
townsfolk2.text: We'll keep our shutters barred here, but somebody has to face Skarn at Varga Tower. May your luck hold on that cursed hill, stranger!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hobart
offer.text:
It's an outrage! I've been swindled!

I bought the farm east of the well for next to nothing, and nobody told me an Ogre lives in the hayloft! He eats my cabbages, he snores all night and he won't budge! That brute is worse than a hailstorm!

Get him out of my barn, stranger, and I'll make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Hobart
completion.text: You did it! The hayloft is empty at last! Here, take this Bow, it's yours. Go tell Mayor Quillon -- he said nobody could shift that Ogre!

journal.text:
Drive the Ogre out of Hobart's barn in order to earn a reward.

The Ogre is most likely asleep in the hayloft.

guard.speaker: Wendt
guard.text: You're awful scrawny for an Ogre-fighter. Hah, hah, hah...!

shop.speaker: Krell
shop.text: Business is a bit dead this week, with the cabbage harvest and all.

townsfolk1.speaker: Posey
townsfolk1.text: Mother says I'm not supposed to speak to outsiders.

townsfolk2.speaker: Bessa
townsfolk2.text: Eww! I saw a big hairy Ogre sit right down in Mayor Quillon's pig trough!
